name: Fire Formation - Gyokkou
card_text: Activate this card by targeting 1 Set Spell/Trap your opponent controls. Your opponent cannot activate the targeted card in response to this card's activation. While this card is face-up on the field, that Set card cannot be activated. All Beast-Warrior monsters you control gain 100 ATK.
